title: Play In to Out plays only the marked stretch
goal: With an In and an Out set on the timeline, a person can play just the marked stretch and stop at the Out, the way Premiere's Play In to Out does, so they can check a stretch before exporting or extracting it. Plain play keeps running to the end as it does today.
notes: Split out of export-and-playback-keep-to-the-in-and-out-marks, whose title named playback but whose acceptance covered export only; export shipped there. Premiere binds Play In to Out to Cmd+Shift+Space on Mac (check before binding: TimelineMenuKeys). Marks: PhotonzDocument.markedRangeMS / exportRangeMS(.marked) in Sources/PhotonzCore/VideoExportRange.swift. Ruler menu rows: EditorState+TimelineMenus.swift timelineRulerMenuRows.
acceptance: With In and Out set, Play In to Out (Premiere's key, and a row on the ruler right-click menu) starts at the In and stops at the Out
With no marks set the command is absent or plays the whole video
A walk at Next defaults sets marks, plays In to Out and checks the playhead stops at the Out

log.note: review before building: Premiere's Mac key is Option-K, already Go to Previous Key here (EditorCommands); binding Premiere's Windows chord with Cmd for Ctrl (Cmd-Shift-Space), which nothing else uses. No mock shows the command, so it lives in the Video menu and the ruler right-click menu beside Set In/Set Out.

built: TimelineKeyCommand.playInToOut + PhotonzDocument.playInToOutMS (tests first in TimelineKeysTests); EditorState.playInToOut sets documentPlaybackStopMS which restartDocumentClock stops at; cleared on pause and on a J/K/L rate change.

verified: Scripts/test.sh green (10413 tests); play-in-to-out-walk and play-in-to-out-from-the-ruler-walk ok at Next defaults with real captures; extract-from-the-ruler-menu, export-keeps-to-the-in-and-out and timeline-right-click walks still ok.
left rough (no task: nobody is stopped by it): J/K/L during a Play In to Out takes over and runs past the Out; no transport button for Play In to Out. Both in the audit's rough list.

Cmd-Shift-Space, a ruler right-click row and a Video menu row play from the In and stop on the Out; plain Space unchanged; no marks = key does nothing, row dimmed/absent. Tests first in TimelineKeysTests, Scripts/test.sh green, play-in-to-out-walk + play-in-to-out-from-the-ruler-walk ok at Next defaults with real captures.
